title: config/precedence.yaml (drydocs.precedence.v1)
description:
Shape only (S6). Resolution semantics live in drydocs_core/precedence.py and tests/unit/test_precedence.py.

CLOSED AT THE TOP LEVEL (CFG3, 2026-09-07), the three sibling family schemas' rule: an open schema accepts a misspelled key in silence, and a config nobody validates is a config that drifts. Closing it surfaced one real omission -- `classification`, live in the file and declared nowhere -- which is the whole argument for closing, in one key.

STILL OPEN, deliberately and named so it is not mistaken for an oversight: `conflict_policy` is `type: object` with no properties (live keys: winner, loser_disposition, never, require_sme_confirmation) and the `order[]` items accept extra keys. Both are the same defect one level down; CFG3 is scoped to the top level and they are handed back rather than swept in.

updated.description: date or string (YAML parses bare dates)

stamp.description: G72 (SS-D3): the Attribution.source value this surface stamps — attribution-surface entries only

classification.description: J58 identity header. Present in the live file and undeclared until CFG3, which is exactly what an open schema hides.

source.description: J58 identity header, optional here: a file authored in this repository names no upstream extract. Declared so closing the schema cannot make the header profile unsatisfiable.
